feature_queries.name: user_base
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.UserId, e.timestamp,
       DATE_DIFF('day', u.CreationDate, e.timestamp) AS account_age_days,
       EXTRACT('month' FROM e.timestamp) AS asof_month,
       CASE WHEN u.Location IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_location,
       LENGTH(COALESCE(u.Location,'')) AS location_len,
       CASE WHEN u.AboutMe IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_about,
       LENGTH(COALESCE(u.AboutMe,'')) AS about_len
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = e.UserId

feature_queries.name: badge_hist
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.UserId, e.timestamp,
       COUNT(b.Id) AS badges_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_last365d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_last90d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_last30d,
       COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(b.Date), e.timestamp), 99999) AS days_since_last_badge,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.Name) AS badge_name_diversity
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN badges b
  ON b.UserId = e.UserId AND b.Date < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.UserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: badge_composition
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.UserId, e.timestamp,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_class1_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_class2_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_class3_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.TagBased THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_tagbased_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND b.Class=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_class1_90d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND b.Class=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_class2_90d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND b.Class=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_class3_90d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' AND b.TagBased THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_tagbased_90d
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId=e.UserId AND b.Date < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.UserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: posts_agg
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.UserId, e.timestamp,
       COUNT(p.Id) AS posts_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_last365d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_last90d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_last30d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_last7d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS questions_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answers_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId = 1 AND p.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS questions_last90d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId = 2 AND p.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answers_last90d,
       COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(p.CreationDate), e.timestamp), 99999) AS days_since_last_post
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN posts p
  ON p.OwnerUserId = e.UserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.UserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: external_comments_on_own_posts
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.UserId, e.timestamp,
       COUNT(c.Id) AS ext_comments_on_own_posts_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ext_comments_on_own_posts_365d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ext_comments_on_own_posts_90d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ext_comments_on_own_posts_30d,

       COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(c.CreationDate), e.timestamp), 99999) AS days_since_last_ext_comment_on_own_posts
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId=e.UserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.PostId=p.Id AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp AND c.UserId != e.UserId
GROUP BY e.UserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: votes_received_on_posts
feature_queries.sql:
SELECT e.UserId, e.timestamp,
       COUNT(v.Id) AS votes_recv_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_recv_last365d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_recv_last90d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_recv_last30d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_recv_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_recv_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 2 AND v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_recv_last90d,
       SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 3 AND v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_recv_last90d,
       COUNT(DISTINCT v.UserId) AS distinct_voters_total,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN v.UserId END) AS distinct_voters_90d,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN v.UserId END) AS distinct_voters_365d,
       COALESCE(DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(v.CreationDate), e.timestamp), 99999) AS days_since_last_vote_recv
FROM eval_table e
LEFT JOIN posts p
  ON p.OwnerUserId = e.UserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp
LEFT JOIN votes v
  ON v.PostId = p.Id AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp
GROUP BY e.UserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: ratios_from_aggs
feature_queries.sql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT e.UserId, e.timestamp,
         SUM(CASE WHEN posts.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_90,
         SUM(CASE WHEN posts.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_30,
         SUM(CASE WHEN posts.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_7,
         SUM(CASE WHEN posts.PostTypeId=2 AND posts.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ans_90,
         SUM(CASE WHEN posts.PostTypeId=1 AND posts.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q_90
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.OwnerUserId=e.UserId AND posts.CreationDate < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY e.UserId, e.timestamp
),
 b AS (
  SELECT e.UserId, e.timestamp,
         SUM(CASE WHEN badges.Date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '365 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badge_365,
         SUM(CASE WHEN badges.Date >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badge_90
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN badges ON badges.UserId=e.UserId AND badges.Date < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY e.UserId, e.timestamp
),
 c AS (
  SELECT e.UserId, e.timestamp,
         SUM(CASE WHEN comments.CreationDate >= e.timestamp - INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comm_90
  FROM eval_table e
  LEFT JOIN comments ON comments.UserId=e.UserId AND comments.CreationDate < e.timestamp
  GROUP BY e.UserId, e.timestamp
)
SELECT p.UserId, p.timestamp,
       CASE WHEN posts_90>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_posts_90d,
       CASE WHEN posts_30>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_posts_30d,
       COALESCE(ans_90 * 1.0 / NULLIF(posts_90,0), 0.0) AS frac_answers_90d,
       COALESCE(q_90 * 1.0 / NULLIF(posts_90,0), 0.0) AS frac_questions_90d,
       COALESCE(comm_90 * 1.0 / NULLIF(posts_90,0), 0.0) AS comments_per_post_90d,
       COALESCE(badge_90 * 1.0 / NULLIF(posts_90,0), 0.0) AS badges_per_post_90d,
       COALESCE(badge_365 * 1.0 / NULLIF(posts_90,0), 0.0) AS badges_per_post_365_over_posts90,
       COALESCE(posts_7 * 1.0 / NULLIF(posts_30,0), 0.0) AS velocity_7_over_30,
       COALESCE(posts_30 * 1.0 / NULLIF(posts_90,0), 0.0) AS velocity_30_over_90
FROM p
LEFT JOIN b USING (UserId, timestamp)
LEFT JOIN c USING (UserId, timestamp)
